subject: math
title: Continuity with test sequences
procedure: Sequence criterion: prove continuity or disprove it with two test sequences
promptTemplate: Give a function f: ℝ → ℝ (piecewise defined if needed) and a point x0. easy: an obvious jump. medium: a root or absolute value term. exam: a parameter for which continuity holds or fails, argued with test sequences. When checking: choice of sequences (do they converge to x0?), limits of the function values, conclusion.
answerFormat: Claim, test sequences, limit calculation, conclusion.
